none: PAS CAM-E4D633: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is Lyon, AD330-331, Reece period 17. Obverse shows helmeted bust (Roma) left. Obverse legend reads VRBS ROMA. Reverse shows wolf and twins, two stars above. Reverse legend - . Reverse fields and exergue read: / //.PLG. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.10g, diameter is 16.84mm. See RIC VII, p.138, no.247
